+
+## 合同与拥有层
+
+`packages/core/src/scroll.ts` 已定义 `ScrollSurfaceRequest` 和 `ScrollSurfaceRequestOutcome`。请求结果是 `dispatched`、`queued` 或带 `not-mounted` / `not-declared` / `unavailable` 原因的 `rejected`。`C-SCROLL-0001-C` 的 `to.position` 是归一化位置；`C-SCROLL-0001-AVAILABILITY` 禁止把不可用请求缓存到未来 view；`queued` 只属于同步 attachment transaction。`dispatched` 表示送到当前宿主引擎，不保证用户最终看到目标。
+
+`C-SCROLL-TARGET-REVEAL-0001` 与 `HC-SCROLL-SURFACE-0001-TARGET-REVEAL` 分别拥有逻辑身份准入和宿主几何。当前 family、part、nearest same-role surface 与 view authority 必须持续有效；Web 宿主只移动自己的 vertical offset，保留 focus、horizontal offset 和 ancestor offset。有效的 reveal（包括 no-op）可以取代旧 pending end 请求，无效 reveal 不可以取消它。reveal 不排队或重放。
+
+现行 `T-SCROLL-TARGET-REVEAL-0001` 只记录 Runtime / model 证据，明确不能认证 Compiler 或非 Web；native Search 的独立未完成条件保持不变。本修复不修改这些实体的生命周期或扩充语义豁免。
+
+## 第一检查点：请求类型与 Web position 消费

+Compiler 的原 `scroll.request` 规则只接受粗粒度 `record` 并返回 `void`。生成的 DOM helper 把 `to.position` 当作像素，也把 view 不可用时的请求写入 `pendingScroll`，随后在另一个 view 上重放。普通 React、Vue 3、Vue 2 和 Web Component 消费者均实际重现了这些行为。
+
+修复在 Core 类型映射中保留请求的 discriminant 与 Anatomy 名义字段；operation 现在产生结构化结果。Scroll 参数单独使用有限的 `valueSchema`，没有放宽其他 operation 的 `types` 或 `module-config` 规则。DOM helper 的 position 路径以同一 physical root 与 generation 计算、写入和检查结果；`to` 与 `control-drag` 使用归一化范围；不可用请求不再进入跨 view 缓存。

+// @vitest-environment node
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

+const choice = `type Choice={kind:'data';value:number}|{kind:'runner';run:()=>number};`;
+const source = (body: string) => `import{definePrototype}from'@proto.ui/core';${choice}
+export default definePrototype({name:'checked-scroll-value',setup(def){${body}return r=>r.slot();}});`;
+function checked(input: string): PrototypeIR {
+  const parsed = parsePrototype(input);
+  expect(parsed.ok, JSON.stringify(parsed.ok ? {} : parsed.diagnostics)).toBe(true);
+  if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error('source rejected');
+  const portable = validateIR(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(parsed.value)));
+  expect(portable.ok, JSON.stringify(portable.ok ? {} : portable.diagnostics)).toBe(true);
+  if (!portable.ok) throw new Error('portable IR rejected');
+  return portable.value;
+}
+function records(value: unknown): Record<string, any>[] {
+  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return [];
+  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.flatMap(records);
+  return [value as Record<string, any>, ...Object.values(value).flatMap(records)];
+}
+const reveal = `import{definePrototype,createAnatomyFamily,type ScrollSurfaceRequest}from'@proto.ui/core';
+import{asScrollSurface}from'@proto.ui/hooks';
+const FAMILY=createAnatomyFamily('checked-reveal',{roles:{root:{cardinality:{min:1,max:1}},item:{cardinality:{min:0,max:'*'}}}});
+export default definePrototype({name:'checked-reveal',setup(def){
+  def.anatomy.claim(FAMILY,{role:'root'});const scroll=asScrollSurface();
+  def.anatomy.subscribeParts(FAMILY,'item',(_run,parts)=>{
+    const part=parts[0];if(part){
+      const request:ScrollSurfaceRequest={kind:'reveal',axis:'vertical',family:FAMILY,part};
+      scroll.request(request);
+    }
+  });return r=>r.slot();
+}});`;
+const requestSource = (request: string) => `import{definePrototype}from'@proto.ui/core';
+import{asScrollSurface}from'@proto.ui/hooks';export default definePrototype({name:'checked-request',setup(def){
+const scroll=asScrollSurface();def.expose.method('request',(flag:boolean)=>scroll.request(${request}));return r=>r.slot();}});`;
+
+describe('checked evidence for Scroll records containing nominal alternatives', () => {
+  it('proves the concrete data arm of a mixed annotation without granting callable authority', () => {
+    checked(source(`const value:Choice={kind:'data',value:7};def.expose.method('read',()=>value.kind);`));
+  });
+
+  it('retains verified family and part fields in an annotated reveal request', () => {
+    checked(reveal);
+  });
+
+  it('checks both concrete branches of a conditional request', () => {
+    checked(requestSource(`flag?{kind:'by',axis:'vertical',delta:2}:{kind:'to',axis:'vertical',position:0.5}`));
+  });
+
+  it('does not recover a mutable alias discriminant from its initializer', () => {
+    expect(parsePrototype(source(`const raw={kind:'data',value:7};raw.kind='runner';const value:Choice=raw;`)))
+      .toMatchObject({ ok: false, diagnostics: [{ code: 'PUI1006' }] });
+  });
+
+  it('does not hide a callable behind the data arm of a mixed annotation', () => {
+    expect(parsePrototype(source(`const value:Choice={kind:'data',value:7,hidden:()=>1};`)))
+      .toMatchObject({ ok: false, diagnostics: [{ code: 'PUI1006' }] });
+  });
+
+  it('rejects a conditional request with one malformed possible branch', () => {
+    expect(parsePrototype(requestSource(`flag?{kind:'by',axis:'vertical',delta:2}:{kind:'to',axis:'vertical',position:'bad'}`)))
+      .toMatchObject({ ok: false, diagnostics: [{ code: 'PUI1006' }] });
+  });
+
+  it('does not erase a callable hidden in a Scroll position request', () => {
+    expect(parsePrototype(requestSource(`{kind:'by',axis:'vertical',delta:2,hidden:()=>1}`)))
+      .toMatchObject({ ok: false, diagnostics: [{ code: 'PUI1006' }] });
+  });
+
+  it('checks a literal type before using its value as annotation evidence', () => {
+    const ir = checked(requestSource(`{kind:'by',axis:'vertical',delta:7}`));
+    const operation = records(ir).find((node) => node.kind === 'operation' && node.operation === 'scroll.request')!;
+    const value = operation.arguments[0];

+  it('does not recover literal facts from a serialized broad reference', () => {

+    value.value = { kind: 'narrow', value: value.value, type: SCROLL_REQUEST_TYPE, span: value.span };
+    expect(validateIR(ir)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, diagnostics: [{ code: 'PUI2002' }] });
+  });
+
+  it('does not accept an ordinary record with forged nominal Anatomy metadata', () => {
+    const ir = checked(reveal.replace(
+      /const request:ScrollSurfaceRequest=(\{[^;]+\});\s*scroll.request\(request\);/,
+      'scroll.request($1);'

+    const part = request.entries.find((entry: any) => entry.key === 'part');
+    part.value = { kind: 'record', entries: [], type: 'anatomy-part', span: part.value.span };
+    expect(validateIR(ir)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, diagnostics: [{ code: 'PUI2002' }] });
+  });
+});

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { mountNativeOwner, nativeOwnerProfiles, type NativeOwnerProfile } from './native-owner-consumer';
+
+const cleanup: (() => void | Promise<void>)[] = [];
+afterEach(async () => {
+  for (const dispose of cleanup.splice(0).reverse()) await dispose();
+  document.body.replaceChildren();
+});
+
+const source = `import {definePrototype,type RunHandle} from '@proto.ui/core';
+import {asScrollSurface} from '@proto.ui/hooks';
+export default definePrototype({name:'scroll-position-consumer',setup(def){
+  const scroll=asScrollSurface();
+  scroll.configure({axes:'vertical',projection:'system'});
+  let current:RunHandle<{}>|null=null;
+  def.lifecycle.onCreated(run=>{current=run;});
+  def.expose.method('to',(position:number)=>scroll.request({kind:'to',axis:'vertical',position}));
+  def.expose.method('by',(delta:number)=>scroll.request({kind:'by',axis:'vertical',delta}));
+  def.expose.method('read',()=>scroll.getSnapshot());
+  def.expose.method('hide',()=>current?.lifecycle.setPresent(false));
+  def.expose.method('show',()=>current?.lifecycle.setPresent(true));
+  return r=>r.el('section',r.slot());
+}});`;
+
+/** Explicit model geometry, including replacement roots; no browser layout claim. */
+function geometry() {
+  const prototype = HTMLElement.prototype;
+  for (const [name, extent] of Object.entries({ clientHeight: 200, scrollHeight: 1000, clientWidth: 200, scrollWidth: 500 })) {
+    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(prototype, name);
+    Object.defineProperty(prototype, name, { configurable: true, get() { return extent; } });
+    cleanup.push(() => {
+      if (descriptor) Object.defineProperty(prototype, name, descriptor);
+      else delete (prototype as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[name];
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+function physicalRoot(host: HTMLElement, profile: NativeOwnerProfile): HTMLElement {
+  const surface = profile === 'web-component-source-v1'
+    ? host.firstElementChild
+    : host.querySelector('[data-pui-root]');
+  if (!(surface instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error('missing ordinary native physical root');
+  return surface;
+}
+
+for (const profile of nativeOwnerProfiles)
+  describe(`C-SCROLL-0001 ordinary ${profile} consumer`, () => {
+    it('returns a dispatched record for a delivered request and reports observed facts', async () => {
+      geometry();
+      const owner = await mountNativeOwner(source, profile);
+      cleanup.push(owner.dispose);
+      const surface = physicalRoot(owner.host, profile);
+      const exposed = owner.handle.getExposes();
+      const outcome = await owner.act(() => exposed.by(80));
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(80);
+      expect(outcome).toEqual({ kind: 'dispatched' });
+      expect(exposed.read().vertical.position).toBe(0.1);
+    });
+
+    it('treats to as a normalized ratio, clamps it, and preserves the horizontal offset', async () => {
+      geometry();
+      const owner = await mountNativeOwner(source, profile);
+      cleanup.push(owner.dispose);
+      const surface = physicalRoot(owner.host, profile);
+      surface.scrollLeft = 17;
+      const exposed = owner.handle.getExposes();
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.to(0.5));
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(400);
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.to(2));
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(800);
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.to(-1));
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(0);
+      expect(surface.scrollLeft).toBe(17);
+    });
+
+    it('rejects a detached request and does not replay it into a replacement view', async () => {
+      geometry();
+      const owner = await mountNativeOwner(source, profile);
+      cleanup.push(owner.dispose);
+      const exposed = owner.handle.getExposes();
+      const previous = owner.host.querySelector('section')!;
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.hide());
+      expect(owner.host.querySelector('section')).toBeNull();
+      const outcome = await owner.act(() => exposed.to(0.75));
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.show());
+      expect(owner.host.querySelector('section')).not.toBe(previous);
+      const replacement = physicalRoot(owner.host, profile);
+      expect(replacement.scrollTop).toBe(0);
+      expect(outcome).toEqual({ kind: 'rejected', reason: 'not-mounted' });
+      expect(await owner.act(() => exposed.to(0.25))).toEqual({ kind: 'dispatched' });
+      expect(replacement.scrollTop).toBe(200);
+    });
+  });

+

+    checked(`${imports}
+      const FAMILY=createAnatomyFamily('scroll-reveal',{roles:{root:{cardinality:{min:1,max:1}},item:{cardinality:{min:0,max:'*'}}}});
+      export default definePrototype({name:'typed-reveal',setup(def){

+    `{kind:'by',axis:'diagonal',delta:20}`,

+    `{kind:'by',axis:'vertical',delta:'20'}`,

+import { mkdir, mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import * as React from 'react';
+import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
+import * as Vue from 'vue';
+import Vue2 from '../../adapters/vue2/node_modules/vue';
+import { compileProject } from '../src/project';
+import { writeProjectCompilation } from '../src/project-output';
+import type { NativeOwnerHandle, NativeOwnerProfile } from './native-owner-consumer';
+
+const cleanup: (() => void | Promise<void>)[] = [];
+let sequence = 0;
+export async function cleanupScrollConsumers() {
+  for (const dispose of cleanup.splice(0).reverse()) await dispose();
+}
+const familyDeclaration = `{roles:{root:{cardinality:{min:1,max:1}},surface:{cardinality:{min:0,max:'*'}},item:{cardinality:{min:0,max:'*'}}}}`;
+const family = `import{createAnatomyFamily}from'@proto.ui/core';
+export const FAMILY=createAnatomyFamily('scroll-consumer-family',${familyDeclaration});
+export const OTHER=createAnatomyFamily('scroll-consumer-family',${familyDeclaration});`;
+const lifecycle = `let current:RunHandle<{}>|null=null;
+def.lifecycle.onCreated(run=>{current=run;});
+def.expose.method('hide',()=>current?.lifecycle.setPresent(false));
+def.expose.method('show',()=>current?.lifecycle.setPresent(true));`;
+const rootSource = `import{definePrototype}from'@proto.ui/core';import{FAMILY}from'./family';
+export default definePrototype({name:'scroll-family-root',setup(def){
+def.anatomy.claim(FAMILY,{role:'root'});return r=>r.slot();}});`;
+const itemSource = `import{definePrototype,type RunHandle}from'@proto.ui/core';import{FAMILY}from'./family';
+export default definePrototype({name:'scroll-family-item',setup(def){
+def.anatomy.claim(FAMILY,{role:'item'});${lifecycle}return r=>r.el('span','item');}});`;
+const surfaceSource = `import{definePrototype,type RunHandle,type ScrollSurfaceRevealRequest}from'@proto.ui/core';
+import{asScrollSurface}from'@proto.ui/hooks';import{FAMILY,OTHER}from'./family';
+export default definePrototype({name:'scroll-family-surface',setup(def){
+def.anatomy.claim(FAMILY,{role:'surface'});${lifecycle}
+const scroll=asScrollSurface();scroll.configure({axes:'vertical',projection:'system',endFollow:{mode:'while-at-end',axis:'vertical'}});
+let saved:ScrollSurfaceRevealRequest|null=null;
+def.expose.method('reveal',(index:number)=>{
+  if(current){const parts=current.anatomy.order.partsOf(FAMILY,'item');const part=index===0?parts[0]:index===1?parts[1]:parts[2];
+    if(part)return scroll.request({kind:'reveal',axis:'vertical',family:FAMILY,part});}
+  return {kind:'rejected',reason:'unavailable'};
+});
+def.expose.method('revealOther',(index:number)=>{
+  if(current){const parts=current.anatomy.order.partsOf(FAMILY,'item');const part=index===0?parts[0]:index===1?parts[1]:parts[2];
+    if(part)return scroll.request({kind:'reveal',axis:'vertical',family:OTHER,part});}
+  return {kind:'rejected',reason:'unavailable'};
+});
+def.expose.method('revealSelf',()=>{
+  if(current){const index=current.anatomy.order.indexOfSelf(FAMILY,'surface');const parts=current.anatomy.order.partsOf(FAMILY,'surface');const part=index===0?parts[0]:index===1?parts[1]:parts[2];
+    if(part)return scroll.request({kind:'reveal',axis:'vertical',family:FAMILY,part});}
+  return {kind:'rejected',reason:'unavailable'};
+});
+def.expose.method('revealSurface',(index:number)=>{
+  if(current){const parts=current.anatomy.order.partsOf(FAMILY,'surface');const part=index===0?parts[0]:index===1?parts[1]:parts[2];
+    if(part)return scroll.request({kind:'reveal',axis:'vertical',family:FAMILY,part});}
+  return {kind:'rejected',reason:'unavailable'};
+});
+def.expose.method('capture',(index:number)=>{
+  if(current){const parts=current.anatomy.order.partsOf(FAMILY,'item');const part=index===0?parts[0]:index===1?parts[1]:parts[2];
+    if(part){const request:ScrollSurfaceRevealRequest={kind:'reveal',axis:'vertical',family:FAMILY,part};saved=request;}}
+});
+def.expose.method('revealSaved',()=>{if(saved)return scroll.request(saved);return{kind:'rejected',reason:'unavailable'};});
+def.expose.method('read',()=>scroll.getSnapshot());
+return r=>r.slot();}});`;
+
+type Name = 'root' | 'surface' | 'direct' | 'nested' | 'nestedItem' | 'sibling' | 'siblingItem';
+type Entry = 'Root' | 'Surface' | 'Item';
+interface Tree {
+  name: Name;
+  entry: Entry;
+  children?: Tree[];
+}
+const tree: Tree = {
+  name: 'root',
+  entry: 'Root',
+  children: [
+    {
+      name: 'surface',
+      entry: 'Surface',
+      children: [
+        { name: 'direct', entry: 'Item' },
+        { name: 'nested', entry: 'Surface', children: [{ name: 'nestedItem', entry: 'Item' }] },
+      ],
+    },
+    { name: 'sibling', entry: 'Surface', children: [{ name: 'siblingItem', entry: 'Item' }] },
+  ],
+};
+
+/** One documented project/writer graph retains family and owner registry identity. */
+export async function mountScrollFamily(profile: NativeOwnerProfile) {
+  const parent = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), 'generated-modules');
+  await mkdir(parent, { recursive: true });
+  const temporary = await mkdtemp(path.join(parent, 'scroll-family-'));
+  cleanup.push(() => rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true }));
+  const author = path.join(temporary, 'author');
+  await mkdir(author);
+  const sources = {
+    'family.ts': family,
+    'root.proto.ts': rootSource,
+    'surface.proto.ts': surfaceSource,
+    'item.proto.ts': itemSource,
+  };
+  for (const [file, contents] of Object.entries(sources))
+    await writeFile(path.join(author, file), contents);
+  const compilation = await compileProject({
+    root: author,
+    entries: ['root.proto.ts', 'surface.proto.ts', 'item.proto.ts'],
+    profile,
+  });
+  if (!compilation.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(compilation.diagnostics));
+  const extension =
+    profile === 'react-dom-source-v1' ? '.tsx' : profile === 'vue2-source-v1' ? '.js' : '.ts';
+  const sourcePaths = {
+    'root.proto.ts': 'Root' + extension,
+    'surface.proto.ts': 'Surface' + extension,
+    'item.proto.ts': 'Item' + extension,
+  };
+  const output = path.join(temporary, 'output');
+  const written = await writeProjectCompilation(compilation.value, output, { sourcePaths });
+  if (!written.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(written.diagnostics));
+  const generated: Record<string, any> = {};
+  for (const file of Object.values(sourcePaths))
+    generated[path.basename(file, extension)] = await import(
+      /* @vite-ignore */ path.join(output, file)
+    );
+  const host = document.createElement('main');
+  document.body.append(host);
+  cleanup.push(() => host.remove());
+  const handles = {} as Record<Name, NativeOwnerHandle>;
+  const collect = (name: Name, value: unknown) => {
+    if (value) handles[name] = value as NativeOwnerHandle;
+  };
+  const removed = new Set<Name>();
+  let flush: () => Promise<void>;
+  let remove: (name: Name) => Promise<void>;
+  if (profile === 'react-dom-source-v1') {
+    (globalThis as any).IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true;
+    const root = createRoot(host);
+    cleanup.push(async () => {
+      await React.act(async () => root.unmount());
+    });
+    const render = (node: Tree): React.ReactElement | null =>
+      removed.has(node.name)
+        ? null
+        : React.createElement(
+            'div',
+            { key: node.name, 'data-scroll-probe': node.name },
+            React.createElement(
+              generated[node.entry].CompiledComponent,
+              { ref: (value: unknown) => collect(node.name, value) },
+              ...(node.children ?? []).map(render)
+            )
+          );
+    await React.act(async () => root.render(render(tree)));
+    flush = async () => {
+      await React.act(async () => {
+        await Promise.resolve();
+      });
+    };
+    remove = async (name) => {
+      removed.add(name);
+      await React.act(async () => root.render(render(tree)));
+    };
+  } else if (profile === 'vue-source-v1') {
+    const revision = Vue.ref(0);
+    const render = (node: Tree): Vue.VNode | null =>
+      removed.has(node.name)
+        ? null
+        : Vue.h('div', { key: node.name, 'data-scroll-probe': node.name }, [
+            Vue.h(
+              generated[node.entry].CompiledComponent,
+              { ref: (value: unknown) => collect(node.name, value) },
+              { default: () => (node.children ?? []).map(render) }
+            ),
+          ]);
+    const app = Vue.createApp({
+      render: () => {
+        void revision.value;
+        return render(tree);
+      },
+    });
+    app.mount(host);
+    cleanup.push(() => app.unmount());
+    flush = async () => {
+      await Promise.resolve();
+      await Vue.nextTick();
+      await Vue.nextTick();
+    };
+    remove = async (name) => {
+      removed.add(name);
+      ++revision.value;
+      await flush();
+    };
+  } else if (profile === 'vue2-source-v1') {
+    const vm = new Vue2({
+      data: () => ({ revision: 0 }),
+      render(h) {
+        void this.revision;
+        const render = (node: Tree): any =>
+          removed.has(node.name)
+            ? null
+            : h('div', { key: node.name, attrs: { 'data-scroll-probe': node.name } }, [
+                h(
+                  generated[node.entry].CompiledComponent,
+                  { ref: node.name },
+                  (node.children ?? []).map(render)
+                ),
+              ]);
+        return render(tree);
+      },
+    });
+    vm.$mount();
+    host.append(vm.$el);
+    cleanup.push(() => vm.$destroy());
+    flush = async () => {
+      await Promise.resolve();
+      await Vue2.nextTick();
+      await Vue2.nextTick();
+      for (const name of Object.keys(vm.$refs)) collect(name as Name, vm.$refs[name]);
+    };
+    remove = async (name) => {
+      removed.add(name);
+      ++vm.revision;
+      await flush();
+    };
+  } else {
+    const tags = {} as Record<Entry, string>;
+    for (const entry of ['Root', 'Surface', 'Item'] as const) {
+      tags[entry] = `x-scroll-${entry.toLowerCase()}-${++sequence}`;
+      generated[entry].register(tags[entry]);
+    }
+    const render = (node: Tree): HTMLElement => {
+      const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
+      wrapper.dataset.scrollProbe = node.name;
+      const element = document.createElement(tags[node.entry]) as HTMLElement &
+        NativeOwnerHandle & { dispose(): void };
+      collect(node.name, element);
+      for (const child of node.children ?? []) element.append(render(child));
+      wrapper.append(element);
+      return wrapper;
+    };
+    host.append(render(tree));
+    cleanup.push(() => {
+      for (const handle of Object.values(handles).reverse())
+        (handle as NativeOwnerHandle & { dispose(): void }).dispose();
+    });
+    flush = async () => {
+      await Promise.resolve();
+      await Promise.resolve();
+    };
+    remove = async (name) => {
+      (handles[name] as NativeOwnerHandle & { dispose(): void }).dispose();
+      host.querySelector(`[data-scroll-probe="${name}"]`)?.remove();
+      await flush();
+    };
+  }
+  await flush();
+  return {
+    host,
+    handles,
+    compilation: compilation.value,
+    output,
+    flush,
+    remove,
+    physical(name: Name): HTMLElement {
+      const wrapper = host.querySelector(`[data-scroll-probe="${name}"]`);
+      const result =
+        profile === 'web-component-source-v1'
+          ? wrapper?.firstElementChild
+          : wrapper?.querySelector('[data-pui-root]');
+      if (!(result instanceof HTMLElement))
+        throw new Error('missing current physical root: ' + name);
+      return result;
+    },
+    async act<T>(callback: () => T): Promise<T> {
+      let value!: T;
+      if (profile === 'react-dom-source-v1')
+        await React.act(async () => {
+          value = callback();
+        });
+      else {
+        value = callback();
+        await flush();
+      }
+      return value;
+    },
+  };
+}

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { nativeOwnerProfiles } from './native-owner-consumer';
+import { cleanupScrollConsumers, mountScrollFamily } from './scroll-reveal-consumer';
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  await cleanupScrollConsumers();
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+  document.body.replaceChildren();
+});
+
+/** Explicit geometry injection exercises emitted host behavior, not browser layout. */
+function geometry(surface: HTMLElement, target: HTMLElement) {
+  Object.defineProperties(surface, {
+    clientWidth: { configurable: true, value: 100 },
+    scrollWidth: { configurable: true, value: 400 },
+    clientHeight: { configurable: true, value: 100 },
+    scrollHeight: { configurable: true, value: 400 },
+    clientTop: { configurable: true, value: 2 },
+    offsetHeight: { configurable: true, value: 104 },
+  });
+  surface.scrollTop = 50;
+  surface.scrollLeft = 17;
+  const state = {
+    start: 150,
+    height: 20,
+    rendered: true,
+    onMeasure: undefined as (() => void) | undefined,
+  };
+  const surfaceBox = () => new DOMRect(20, 100, 104, 104);
+  const targetBox = () => {
+    const callback = state.onMeasure;
+    state.onMeasure = undefined;
+    callback?.();
+    return new DOMRect(22, 102 + state.start - surface.scrollTop, 80, state.height);
+  };
+  vi.spyOn(surface, 'getBoundingClientRect').mockImplementation(surfaceBox);
+  vi.spyOn(surface, 'getClientRects').mockImplementation(
+    () => [surfaceBox()] as unknown as DOMRectList
+  );
+  vi.spyOn(target, 'getBoundingClientRect').mockImplementation(targetBox);
+  vi.spyOn(target, 'getClientRects').mockImplementation(
+    () => (state.rendered ? [targetBox()] : []) as unknown as DOMRectList
+  );
+  return state;
+}
+const unavailable = { kind: 'rejected', reason: 'unavailable' };
+
+for (const profile of nativeOwnerProfiles)
+  describe(`C-SCROLL-TARGET-REVEAL-0001 ordinary ${profile}`, () => {
+    it('reveals a real current part with minimal vertical movement and preserves unrelated host state', async () => {
+      const owner = await mountScrollFamily(profile);
+      const surface = owner.physical('surface'),
+        target = owner.physical('direct');
+      geometry(surface, target);
+      const editor = document.createElement('input');
+      owner.host.prepend(editor);
+      editor.focus();
+      owner.host.scrollTop = 43;
+      owner.host.scrollLeft = 11;
+      expect(await owner.act(() => owner.handles.surface.getExposes().reveal(0))).toEqual({
+        kind: 'dispatched',
+      });
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(70);
+      expect(surface.scrollLeft).toBe(17);
+      expect(owner.host.scrollTop).toBe(43);
+      expect(owner.host.scrollLeft).toBe(11);
+      expect(document.activeElement).toBe(editor);
+      expect(owner.handles.surface.getExposes().read().vertical.position).toBeCloseTo(70 / 300);
+    });
+
+    it('uses resolved insets, native clamping and no movement for a covering target', async () => {
+      const owner = await mountScrollFamily(profile);
+      const surface = owner.physical('surface'),
+        target = owner.physical('direct');
+      const state = geometry(surface, target);
+      surface.style.scrollPaddingTop = '10px';
+      surface.style.scrollPaddingBottom = '15%';
+      target.style.scrollMarginTop = '5px';
+      target.style.scrollMarginBottom = '7px';
+      surface.style.setProperty('scroll-behavior', 'smooth', 'important');
+      const reveal = () => owner.handles.surface.getExposes().reveal(0);
+      expect(await owner.act(reveal)).toEqual({ kind: 'dispatched' });
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(92);
+      expect(surface.style.getPropertyValue('scroll-behavior')).toBe('smooth');
+      expect(surface.style.getPropertyPriority('scroll-behavior')).toBe('important');
+      state.start = 1000;
+      expect(await owner.act(reveal)).toEqual({ kind: 'dispatched' });
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(300);
+      state.start = 250;
+      state.height = 200;
+      expect(await owner.act(reveal)).toEqual({ kind: 'dispatched' });
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(300);
+    });
+
+    it('reveals a descendant surface part whose nearest strict same-role ancestor is this surface', async () => {
+      const owner = await mountScrollFamily(profile);
+      const surface = owner.physical('surface'),
+        target = owner.physical('nested');
+      geometry(surface, target);
+      target.scrollTop = 23;
+      const before = surface.scrollTop;
+      const outcome = await owner.act(() => owner.handles.surface.getExposes().revealSurface(1));
+      expect({ outcome, before, after: surface.scrollTop, nestedOffset: target.scrollTop }).toEqual(
+        {
+          outcome: { kind: 'dispatched' },
+          before: 50,
+          after: 70,
+          nestedOffset: 23,
+        }
+      );
+    });
+
+    it('rejects an item owned by another surface, a sibling, self and another family before physical movement', async () => {
+      const owner = await mountScrollFamily(profile);
+      const surface = owner.physical('surface');
+      geometry(surface, owner.physical('direct'));
+      const exposed = owner.handles.surface.getExposes();
+      expect(await owner.act(() => exposed.reveal(1))).toEqual(unavailable);
+      expect(await owner.act(() => exposed.reveal(2))).toEqual(unavailable);
+      expect(await owner.act(() => exposed.revealSelf())).toEqual(unavailable);
+      expect(await owner.act(() => exposed.revealOther(0))).toEqual(unavailable);
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(50);
+      expect(await owner.act(() => exposed.reveal(0))).toEqual({ kind: 'dispatched' });
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(70);
+    });
+
+    it('rejects a retained part after that logical owner retires', async () => {
+      const owner = await mountScrollFamily(profile);
+      const surface = owner.physical('surface');
+      geometry(surface, owner.physical('direct'));
+      const exposed = owner.handles.surface.getExposes();
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.capture(0));
+      await owner.remove('direct');
+      let beforeRequest = -1,
+        afterSynchronousRequest = -1;
+      const outcome = await owner.act(() => {
+        beforeRequest = surface.scrollTop;
+        const value = exposed.revealSaved();
+        afterSynchronousRequest = surface.scrollTop;
+        return value;
+      });
+      expect(outcome).toEqual(unavailable);
+      // Flush may run an earlier end-follow frame; compare the request's own
+      // synchronous effect. Pending-end ownership has a separate host case.
+      expect(afterSynchronousRequest).toBe(beforeRequest);
+    });
+
+    it('does not replay a reveal from a detached surface into a later view', async () => {
+      const owner = await mountScrollFamily(profile);
+      const surface = owner.physical('surface');
+      geometry(surface, owner.physical('direct'));
+      const exposed = owner.handles.surface.getExposes();
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.capture(0));
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.hide());
+      expect(await owner.act(() => exposed.revealSaved())).toEqual({
+        kind: 'rejected',
+        reason: 'not-mounted',
+      });
+      await owner.act(() => exposed.show());
+      const current = owner.physical('surface');
+      expect(current.scrollTop).toBe(profile === 'web-component-source-v1' ? 50 : 0);
+    });
+
+    it('rechecks target availability after geometry getters synchronously detach the physical target', async () => {
+      const owner = await mountScrollFamily(profile);
+      const surface = owner.physical('surface');
+      const target = owner.physical('direct'),
+        parent = target.parentNode!,
+        next = target.nextSibling;
+      const state = geometry(surface, target);
+      state.onMeasure = () => target.remove();
+      let outcome: unknown;
+      try {
+        outcome = await owner.act(() => owner.handles.surface.getExposes().reveal(0));
+      } finally {
+        parent.insertBefore(target, next);
+      }
+      expect(outcome).toEqual(unavailable);
+      expect(surface.scrollTop).toBe(50);
+    });
+  });

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';

+import { afterEach, expect, it } from 'vitest';

+import { cleanupScrollConsumers, mountScrollFamily } from './scroll-reveal-consumer';
+
+afterEach(async () => {

+
+for (const profile of nativeOwnerProfiles)
+  it(`strictly checks the complete ordinary Scroll family graph as ${profile}`, async () => {

+    const root = process.cwd();

independentSourceReview.scope: Independent read-only Scroll Web source and evidence review

findings.title: A same-role descendant surface part is incorrectly treated as its own ancestor.
findings.implementation: packages/compiler/src/native-support/dom-modules.template.ts:1037-1042 uses ancestor(participant, role predicate); ancestor at 233 starts with owner itself.
findings.contract: C-SCROLL-TARGET-REVEAL-0001-IDENTITY requires the nearest surface-role ancestor to be this surface; it does not ban descendants merely because their own role equals the surface role.
findings.impact: An outer surface cannot reveal the inner surface part itself even though the current Runtime strict ancestor is that outer surface. Revealing an item below that inner same-role surface must still be rejected.
findings.minimumRepairDirection: Exclude participant itself only from the nearest same-role lookup. Preserve inclusive domain-root checks and the explicit self rejection.
findings.requiredClosure: Four ordinary profile positive controls with the same-role descendant surface itself; preserve current self and nested-item negatives. Parent and author are preparing an old-product red before source changes.

resolvedQuestions.reason: Both C-SCROLL-TARGET-REVEAL-0001-IDENTITY and the Runtime select the requesting surface own Anatomy role. Runtime resolveAncestorInstance compares that role and does not test asScrollSurface on every ancestor. HC target-reveal limits which physical surface is moved but adds no all-scroll-hook logical barrier.
resolvedQuestions.action: No fabricated negative control or broader semantic rejection was requested.

reviewedProperties.evidence: Parser retains erasesRuntimeAuthority before initializer proof. Portable narrow recursively validates the full source expression and recorded types before argumentValue; reference facts remain their checked type. Record and conditional proof retain nominal fields and valueAssignable authority erasure. Forged nominal metadata does not bypass the final inferred/recorded expression type check.

Private parts registry, family/domain identity, current claim/owner aliveness, physical targets registry, same target identity and binding generation are rechecked before geometry, after measurement, after cancellation callbacks and after facts publication.

Reveal rejects while attachment is acquiring and never joins its queue. Position queue belongs to the current attachment identity. Facts publish after resource acquisition; old catch/unmount cannot tear down a new generation. Queue flush checks the binding before each item.

reviewedProperties.result: no additional blocker found for the scoped cases
reviewedProperties.evidence: End work owns a distinct object plus binding and axis. It is reserved before pending notification and checked before RAF registration. Cancellation clears ownership before notifying. A cancelled old callback checks object identity before clearing newer work. Valid no-op reveal cancels matching prior end work; invalid target checks precede cancellation.
Each observed set captures both generation and root; a null-view reset cannot borrow a later mounted root while the FIFO queue drains. Existing notification aggregation remains unchanged.

NATIVE_SCROLL_REVEAL_SOURCE is byte-identical to packages/modules/scroll/src/web/target-reveal.ts after only private function renaming and removal of export. It imports no Runtime/Core/Adapter code and changes only surface.scrollTop, preserving horizontal/focus/ancestor offsets. Geometry and computed-inset support remain bounded to the existing algorithm.

Only anatomy-family and anatomy-part with reached interaction support map to existing NativeModuleCapability. There is no cast that fabricates Runtime identity, Core alias expansion or changed emitted runtime expression.

existingUnverifiedRisks.observation: The applied status and following state are published consecutively without a currentView check between them. A synchronous applied subscriber replacing the view could allow the old call to continue a following-state write.
existingUnverifiedRisks.baselineConservation: The same two-set tail exists in base 385d7c706c9e4c35280878efbb6e42d63d7df786.
existingUnverifiedRisks.limit: No actual red or admission claim for this adjacent scenario. Parent informed; not used to expand this patch or testing scope.

minimalScenarioSuggestion.status: static design only; not written or executed
minimalScenarioSuggestion.setup: Use the existing emitted-support fixture at scrollTop=50, viewport=100, extent=400 and its current item at layout start=150. Register an endFollow.requestStatus.watch callback before issuing a vertical to-end request.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.callback: On the first applied event, call the already-public current-part reveal request and record both its outcome and endFollow.state.get(). The item is above the now-ended viewport, so accepted reveal should move to a non-end position and leave state paused.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.outerObservation: After the outer to-end call returns, read endFollow.state.get() and the physical offset. The current tail statically appears able to reset following after the nested reveal recorded paused. No invented pause method or writes to readonly facts are needed.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.meaning: This minimal same-view case tests newer explicit reveal causality, not epoch replacement; a currentView check alone may not close it. If the parent instead wants an epoch-specific control, prepare and mount a replacement view/current item within the applied callback, issue that new view reveal, and compare paused before the old tail resumes.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.guardrails: Do not expand the current strict-ancestor round. If later authorized, preserve old-product and candidate identities and first establish a real public observation before selecting any repair.

The selective six-probe run records three passed, three failed, and 35 unselected: two notification error-identity failures plus the retained retirement timing assertion. Its skipped denominator is explicit.

v3 reran the same four ordinary graph strict cases unchanged after only the two-atom Vue2 JSDoc repair: 4 pass, exit 0. The v2/v3 receipts bind before inputs only; they do not prove historical after-input equality.

The later related46 receipt has actual before/after equality: native-support-capabilities 9, native-support-plan 25 and scroll-position-consumers 12, all passed. It does not cover the newly found strict-ancestor case.

inheritedUnverifiedRisk.observation: The applied status and following state are published consecutively without a currentView check between them. A synchronous applied subscriber replacing the view could allow the old call to continue a following-state write.
inheritedUnverifiedRisk.baselineConservation: The same two-set tail exists in base 385d7c706c9e4c35280878efbb6e42d63d7df786.
inheritedUnverifiedRisk.limit: No actual red or admission claim for this adjacent scenario. Parent informed; not used to expand this patch or testing scope.

minimalScenarioSuggestion.status: static design only; not written or executed
minimalScenarioSuggestion.setup: Use the existing emitted-support fixture at scrollTop=50, viewport=100, extent=400 and its current item at layout start=150. Register an endFollow.requestStatus.watch callback before issuing a vertical to-end request.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.callback: On the first applied event, call the already-public current-part reveal request and record both its outcome and endFollow.state.get(). The item is above the now-ended viewport, so accepted reveal should move to a non-end position and leave state paused.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.outerObservation: After the outer to-end call returns, read endFollow.state.get() and the physical offset. The current tail statically appears able to reset following after the nested reveal recorded paused. No invented pause method or writes to readonly facts are needed.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.meaning: This minimal same-view case tests newer explicit reveal causality, not epoch replacement; a currentView check alone may not close it. If the parent instead wants an epoch-specific control, prepare and mount a replacement view/current item within the applied callback, issue that new view reveal, and compare paused before the old tail resumes.
minimalScenarioSuggestion.guardrails: Do not expand the current strict-ancestor round. If later authorized, preserve old-product and candidate identities and first establish a real public observation before selecting any repair.
